name: mAlb Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of mAlb using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of microalbuminuria (mAlb) in human urine samples. An elevated mAlb concentration below the proteinuric level has long been recognized as a marker of kidney disease and increased cardiovascular risk in diabetic nephropathy.
